people.name: Lazarus
people.line: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead

people.name: Mary
people.line: Sister of Martha and Lazarus, sat at Jesus' feet.

translations.web: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother, Lazarus, was sick.
translations.bsb: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)
translations.kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
translations.asv: And it was that Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
